replacements.La distribución del conjunto de entrenam: The training-set distribution determines what the model knows how to do. Weaknesses in the foundation are amplified at every later stage.
replacements.La distribución de los datos de entrenam: The training-data distribution is reflected directly in the model's capability profile. CLIP generalized well on common categories and systematically worse on infrequent categories even when image quality was equivalent. Fixing the problem required rebalancing the data, not changing the architecture.
replacements.Con datos ruidosos o categorías subrepre: With noisy data or underrepresented categories, the model learns representations that are statistically strong but fragile in fine details.
replacements.El modelo aprende a seguir instrucciones: The model learns to follow instructions, but it cannot repair weak representations from the previous stage. Synthetic data generated with GPT-4 also inherit the generator model's blind spots.
replacements.Captura preferencias sobre formato y est: It captures preferences about response format and style, but it cannot repair weaknesses in base perception. It can also introduce additional biases depending on evaluator criteria.
replacements.un modelo con arquitectura subóptima ent: a model with a suboptimal architecture trained on high-quality data outperforms a state-of-the-art architecture trained on noisy data. Fixing weaknesses requires rebalancing the data at the relevant stage, not adding more stages on top.
